title: Parking License Service Charges — Remotes, Hang Tags and Space Moves
content:
Notes to the schedule of charges: three service charges of the Parking License are set per product — the charge for each lost or additional gate remote, the charge for each replacement permit hang tag or decal, and the charge for moving the license to another space of the same product.

| Parking product | Per lost or additional gate remote | Per replacement hang tag or decal | Move to another space of the same product |
|---|---|---|---|
| Surface Unreserved Permit | $0.00 | $15.00 | $0.00 |
| Surface Reserved Space | $0.00 | $15.00 | $25.00 |
| Covered Carport Space | $0.00 | $15.00 | $25.00 |
| Structured Garage Space | $45.00 | $15.00 | $35.00 |
| EV Charging Reserved Space | $45.00 | $15.00 | $35.00 |
| Private Detached Garage | $45.00 | $0.00 | $50.00 |

## Notes

1. The remote charge applies per remote: two lost remotes on a Structured Garage Space license are two charges of $45.00 each.
2. The hang tag charge is $15.00 on every product except the Private Detached Garage, where it is $0.00.
3. The move charge is $0.00 on the Surface Unreserved Permit and rises with the product, from $25.00 on the Surface Reserved Space and Covered Carport Space to $50.00 on the Private Detached Garage.
